purpose: Test whether a held-out session is more consistent with the same individual's other sessions than with each alternative individual, without averaging alternatives into a pooled population predictor.

datasets.source_file: Straw-colored fruit bats (Eidolon helvum) in Africa 2009-2014-gps.csv

common.self_predictor: equal-session conditional distribution from target individual's other sessions
common.alternative_predictor: equal-session conditional distribution from one alternative individual's sessions
common.scored_rows: target fixes in cells supported by both self and that alternative
common.marginal_pairwise_gain: on the exact same scored target fixes, mean log P_self(z) - log P_alternative(z)
common.aggregation: equal session within individual, then equal individual

prediction: conditional self-win fraction exceeds marginal self-win fraction
conditional pairwise gain exceeds marginal pairwise gain
claim_boundary: does not turn GPS fixes into independent replicates
does not establish foraging or intrinsic personality
pairwise outcome cannot retune completed Tadarida or Eidolon primary endpoints
